name: Life spaceship b22eedfa on 3-uniform tiling k3-040
description: A period-8 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-040, with touching neighbours, 8 to 12 cells, moving two lattice steps every 8 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 32,768 rules from B3/S23 to B3,8,9,10,11,12,13,14/S2,3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14. JETCARP's Life census met it in 13 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
